speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Unstable Meniscus Tear (Lateral)
Based on your age, the specific mechanism of repetitive pivoting and twisting in volleyball, and the worsening pain, this is highly suggestive of a meniscal tear. Can you tell me if you heard a "pop" when it started or if you are currently unable to fully straighten the knee?
